name: Seated Deity Sculpture
shortDescription: A serene seated deity with detailed ornamentation and lotus base.
description: Carved with devotional precision, this seated deity rests upon a lotus pedestal framed by ornate jewellery, crown and drapery. The calm expression and finely worked adornments make it a graceful addition to a home mandir, meditation corner or curated shelf.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for a home temple?
faqs.answer: Yes, its size and serene detailing make it well suited to a home mandir or meditation space.

faqs.question: What wood is used?
faqs.answer: It is carved from seasoned rosewood, prized for its density and rich natural tone.

faqs.question: Is it hand-finished?
faqs.answer: Every piece is hand-carved and hand-polished, so grain and detailing vary slightly between sculptures.
